title: Jesus Forgives Sins and Claims Authority

questions.question: When Jesus returned to Capernaum, the house was so crowded that four men could not bring a paralytic through the door. What did they do?
options: They removed the roof above him, and when they had made an opening, they let down the bed
They waited outside for three days until the crowd dispersed
They shouted through a window for Jesus to heal him
They broke through the wall of the house
questions.correctAnswer: They removed the roof above him, and when they had made an opening, they let down the bed
questions.explanation: Mark 2:4 (ESV): "And when they could not get near him because of the crowd, they removed the roof above him, and when they had made an opening, they let down the bed..."

questions.question: When Jesus saw their faith, what was the first thing He said to the paralytic?
options: "Son, your sins are forgiven."
"Rise, pick up your bed, and go home."
"Do you believe that I can do this?"
"Your faith has made you well."
questions.explanation: Mark 2:5 (ESV): "And when Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, 'Son, your sins are forgiven.'"

questions.question: What did the scribes question in their hearts when Jesus forgave the man's sins?
options: "Why does this man speak like that? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
"How can a carpenter heal illnesses?"
"Does he not know this man is cursed?"
"Why does he not demand a sacrifice?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Why does this man speak like that? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
questions.explanation: Mark 2:7 (ESV): "Why does this man speak like that? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

questions.question: To prove that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins, what did Jesus tell the paralytic to do?
options: "I say to you, rise, pick up your bed, and go home."
"Stand and walk around the room."
"Go and show yourself to the priest."
"Praise the Lord for your healing."
questions.correctAnswer: "I say to you, rise, pick up your bed, and go home."
questions.explanation: Mark 2:10-11 (ESV): "...he said to the paralytic—'I say to you, rise, pick up your bed, and go home.'"

questions.question: Whom did Jesus see sitting at the tax booth and command to follow Him?
options: Levi the son of Alphaeus
Zacchaeus
Nicodemus
Matthew the son of Zebedee
questions.explanation: Mark 2:14 (ESV): "And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth, and he said to him, 'Follow me.'" (Also known as Matthew).

questions.question: When the scribes of the Pharisees saw Jesus eating with sinners and tax collectors, they asked His disciples why He did so. What was Jesus' response?
options: "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners."
"I eat with them because they welcome me."
"The poor give more generously than the rich."
"Because their tithes are acceptable to God."
questions.correctAnswer: "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners."
questions.explanation: Mark 2:17 (ESV): "And when Jesus heard it, he said to them, 'Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.'"

questions.question: People asked Jesus why John's disciples and the Pharisees' disciples fast, but His disciples do not. Jesus compared His disciples to whom?
options: Wedding guests while the bridegroom is with them
Children playing in the marketplace
Soldiers at a great feast
Harvesters in the field
questions.correctAnswer: Wedding guests while the bridegroom is with them
questions.explanation: Mark 2:19 (ESV): "And Jesus said to them, 'Can the wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them?'"

questions.question: When did Jesus say His disciples would fast?
options: "The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day."
"When the Romans conquer Jerusalem."
"On the Day of Atonement only."
"Before they cast out demons."
questions.correctAnswer: "The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day."
questions.explanation: Mark 2:20 (ESV): "The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day."

questions.question: Jesus said that no one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, because if he does, what will happen?
options: The patch tears away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear is made
The new cloth will lose its color
The old garment will refuse the thread
The unshrunk cloth will rot immediately
questions.correctAnswer: The patch tears away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear is made
questions.explanation: Mark 2:21 (ESV): "No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the patch tears away from it... and a worse tear is made."

questions.question: What happens if you put new wine into old wineskins?
options: The wine will burst the skins, and the wine is destroyed, and so are the skins
The old skins will flavor the new wine badly
The skins will stretch but the wine will spoil
The wine will turn into vinegar instantly
questions.correctAnswer: The wine will burst the skins, and the wine is destroyed, and so are the skins
questions.explanation: Mark 2:22 (ESV): "And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins... but new wine is for fresh wineskins."

questions.question: What were the disciples doing on the Sabbath as they went through the grainfields?
options: They began to pluck heads of grain
They were harvesting the entire field with sickles
They set fire to the chaff
They were arguing about the law
questions.correctAnswer: They began to pluck heads of grain
questions.explanation: Mark 2:23 (ESV): "One Sabbath he was going through the grainfields, and as they made their way, his disciples began to pluck heads of grain."

questions.question: When the Pharisees asked why the disciples were doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath, Jesus referenced what David did when he was in need and hungry. What did David do?
options: He entered the house of God and ate the bread of the Presence
He ordered his men to hunt on the Sabbath
He stole sheep from Nabal
He struck the rock for water twice
questions.correctAnswer: He entered the house of God and ate the bread of the Presence
questions.explanation: Mark 2:25-26 (ESV): "Have you never read what David did... how he entered the house of God... and ate the bread of the Presence..."

questions.question: According to Jesus in Mark 2, during whose high priesthood did David enter the house of God and eat the bread of the Presence?
options: Abiathar
Aaron
Eli
Caiaphas
questions.explanation: Mark 2:26 (ESV): "how he entered the house of God, in the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the bread of the Presence..."

questions.question: What principle did Jesus state regarding the Sabbath and humanity?
options: "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath."
"The Sabbath is a burden only for the righteous."
"Man must keep the Sabbath perfectly to be saved."
"The Sabbath was given to Moses alone."
questions.correctAnswer: "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath."
questions.explanation: Mark 2:27 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.'"

questions.question: Because the Sabbath was made for man, what title does Jesus claim in relation to it?
options: "So the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath."
"So the Son of Man commands the Sabbath."
"So the Son of Man abolishes the Sabbath."
"So the Son of Man creates a new Sabbath."
questions.correctAnswer: "So the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath."
questions.explanation: Mark 2:28 (ESV): "So the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath."

key_verse_text: And when Jesus heard it, he said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners."
